$comment: Real client, company and plant names that must not appear in tracked files (check-client-names.mjs). Test data, demos and docs use fictional names (Kestrel Metals Group, Kestrel Aluminium, Riverbend). `exempt` lists the only files allowed to name them: this file, the importer's anonymiser and M0's fixture generator and fixture test, which map the names away or assert they are gone.
